model_lab.policy: Latest archived version of each model, evaluated on identical settled games. Version changes can reset the common sample. Conflicting duplicate events, invalid probabilities, missing result provenance and post-start forecasts are excluded. Descriptive results do not establish a superior future model or profitability. Totals and props are not evaluated by this moneyline archive.

learning_policy.promotion_rule: Candidate must beat frozen default weights on paired daily Brier/log-loss bounds and beat uniform probability; no guarantee of future performance

policy: Forecasts precede kickoff; outcomes use final score sources. Sample counts are per sport/model/version. Learned family weights remain in shadow mode until a separate prospective evaluation passes. Soccer uses three outcomes; its Brier scale differs from binary sports.
